note: Dawson County Fairgrounds in Lexington, just off I-80: an electric-and-water RV campground rented by the night or month outside fair and event dates. Call ahead to reserve. Campers report events booking the grounds (October 2026: turned away for an event, allowed to park in the lot) and horse manure around the barns. The access lane is one-lane. --Claude
summary: Inclusion passes: the county fair rents camper hookups at $25 a night by phone, and RV Life campers paid $25 in July and August 2025. Hookups, booking and dump now manual from the fair's page. Showers, the 48-site count and year-round are not on the page and stay as they were.
flags: INCLUSION passes: the fair's rentals page says 'During the off season of fair, we have a variety of indoor and outdoor facility options available to rent', including 'Camper Hookups-$25 per night'. RV Life reviews show public nightly stays at $25 (July 2025, site 19 'Call to reserve'; August 2025 x2, one 'told we were the only ones scheduled for the upcoming Saturday night'). Events do block it: an October 2026 RV Life review says staff 'said they were busy with another event, but we could park overnight in their parking lot for free.' Fair week isn't posted as blocked, but the page offers rentals 'During the off season of fair'.

RATINGS (local, not gated): RV Life 6.75/10 over 8 ratings. An August 2025 review is titled 'Campers beware. Horse manure everywhere.' (rating 4). Google's fairgrounds listing is 5.0 from 1 review. Neither reaches 25 reviews.
UNSOURCED stored values: showers true, sites.count 48 and season year_round come from 2026-09 note prose; the fair page mentions none of them. Left unchanged (derived), but treat them as unverified.

PIN: stored 40.77100,-99.73600 is in a grass field north of the fairground buildings. Google's fairgrounds point is 40.7720,-99.7368 (~130 m NW). I couldn't pick out hookup pedestals or the camping rows on Esri imagery (a treed gravel double row ~200 m south at ~40.7695,-99.7365 may be them), so no move is proposed.
PHONE 308-324-3600 confirmed (Google listing; the fair page says call the office).
